listingIdentity: research-weekly-loader listingId (provider listing id or SEC binding canonical id); issuerId = securityId; no ticker-only identity

population.rule: createResearchLoader(root, loaderOptions) QUALIFIED weekly listings (current classification = survivors unless listingLifecycleEvidence cuts/excludes series), minus listings with any weekly date label differing from the modal label of its ISO week among QUALIFIED listings, minus listings outside the engine primary exchange set XNAS/XNYS/XASE (exchange from listingId; for identity-evidence bindings the sourced MIC). Same rule as V9 frame, applied to the research loader. Exclusions are counted, never repaired.

availability.decision: Signal/pattern reads weekly closes up to and including the signal week (engine detect/featuresAt).
availability.entry: Close of the next observed calendar week (entryDelayBars = 1, engine NEXT_OBSERVED_WEEK_CLOSE model).
availability.exit: Time exit after h observed calendar weeks; any missing calendar week in the path censors the outcome (engine SESSION_GAP).

benchmark.rule: SPY price return between the same entry and exit dates; events without both SPY dates are excluded from the SPY endpoint and counted.

drawdown: Per-event max drawdown within the holding window (engine) in cells[].coverage.maxDrawdownMedian; portfolio drawdown in funded-strategy-evidence.json

uncertainty.method: research-validation.inferTemporalBlockMean: circular calendar-block bootstrap over the study calendar (all weeks 2000-2025 incl. zero-event weeks; all listings of a week move together = clustering by date), basic centered interval, two-sided p.
uncertainty.blockLength: b = 52 weeks for h <= 26, b = 104 for h = 52 (>= 2h for the 52-week overlap)
uncertainty.secondary: research-studies.inference two-way cluster (signal date x issuer), asymptotic; used for regime, subperiod and descriptive tables.

multipleTesting.definition: 5 rules x 4 horizons x 3 endpoints, Holm over all 60, two-sided H0: mean = 0

controls: Control at week t for rule R: frame listing-weeks that are eligible under the engine signal rule (bar index >= WARMUP 53, date >= listingStart, no calendar gap in the previous WARMUP+COOLDOWN bars), have a completed h-week outcome, and where R.detect is false (cooldown-suppressed detections are NOT controls).
